command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '$nodes = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes"; foreach ($n in $nodes) { $u1 = "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/$($n.node_id)/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $u2 = "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/$($n.node_id)/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $a = ((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u1).output -split "`r?`n") | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration" }; $b = ((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u2).output -split "`r?`n") | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration" }; $d = Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $b -DifferenceObject $a; if ($d) { "=== $($n.name) ==="; $d | ForEach-Object { "$($_.SideIndicator) $($_.InputObject)" } } }'
